abstract.gco:CharacterString: This dataset represents water within a watercourse, assists in determining what authorisations are needed to take water from a watercourse or undertake other activities as covered under the Water Act 2000.

purpose.gco:CharacterString: To assist in managing under the Water Act 2000 the use and availability of water within a watercourse.

supplementalInformation.gco:CharacterString:
Version 119 certified Wednesday 7/10/2026, published Friday 9/10/2026. Updated at the start of the month except January. Mapping scale is variable.
Surface water within a watercourse is defined as being in a river, creek or other stream, including a stream in the form of an anabranch or a tributary, in which water flows permanently or intermittently, regardless of the frequency of flow events. They are a natural channel, whether artificially modified or in an artificial channel that has changed the course of the stream. The watercourses represented by this linear dataset are the longitudinal extent of the watercourses and are upstream of the downstream limit of the watercourse as determined under the Water Act 2000 and the Coastal Protection and Management Act 1995.
Data within this dataset spatially aligns with the state-wide “Watercourse Lines – Queensland” dataset and is a subset of that dataset. The “Watercourse Lines – Queensland” dataset represents the state’s drainage network and shows a way or course through which water flows from time-to-time and are attributed as either perennial or non-perennial. The “Watercourse identification map – watercourses – Queensland” dataset is related to the actual water and other resources within a watercourse.
For further information, visit https://www.business.qld.gov.au/industries/mining-energy-water/water/maps-data/watercourse-map

explanation.gco:CharacterString: New determinations are constantly being made and the data is subject to continual update.
Data should be free from overshoots, undershoots and duplicate lines.

The horizontal positional accuracy of the data that has been used to compile this dataset is as follows: Orthophotography +/- 1m, Satellite Imagery +/- 2.5m, Geoscience Australia 1:250000 Data +/- 20m.

statement.gco:CharacterString: Water Services officers from the Department of Local Government, Water and Volunteers determine if a drainage line meets the requirements of a watercourse as stated in the Water Act 2000. Regional Spatial Information Officers align the location of the watercourse as determined by the Water Services Officers with the centreline of the state-wide “Watercourse Lines – Queensland” dataset and include this information into existing spatial datasets held within the department.
